keyEvents.text: Delay in match (Portsmouth).
Delay in match (Stoke City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Portsmouth 1, Stoke City 0. Tyrese Shade (Portsmouth) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner following a corner.
Delay in match (Stoke City).
Delay in match (Portsmouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ebou Adams (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Junior Tchamadeu (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Portsmouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Regan Poole (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Portsmouth 1, Stoke City 0.
Second Half begins Portsmouth 1, Stoke City 0.
Róbert Bozeník (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Stoke City. Luca Bombino replaces Junior Tchamadeu.
Substitution, Stoke City. George Hirst replaces Róbert Bozeník.
Goal! Portsmouth 1, Stoke City 1. Jack McGlynn (Stoke City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Luca Bombino.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Thomas Waddingham replaces Adrian Segecic.
Delay in match because of an injury Terry Devlin (Portsmouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ethan Galbraith (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Zak Swanson replaces Jayden Meghoma.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Rocco Shein replaces Marlon Pack.
Goal! Portsmouth 1, Stoke City 2. Ben Wilmot (Stoke City) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Josh Murphy replaces Odin Bailey.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Ryan Kavuma-McQueen replaces Abu Kamara.
